title: Post-transcriptional suppression of the pioneer factor Zelda protects the adult Drosophila testis from activation of the ovary program.
authors: Harsh, Sneh; Liu, Hsiao-Yun; Bhaskar, Pradeep K; Rushlow, Christine; Bach, Erika A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇睾丸中pioneer factor Zelda的转录后调控与性别重编程，虽涉及转录因子但核心是组织性别决定而非TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Maintenance of somatic sex identity is essential for adult tissue function. In the Drosophila testis, adult somatic stem cells known as cyst stem cells (CySCs) require the transcription factor Chinmo to preserve male identity. Loss of Chinmo leads to reprogramming of CySCs into their ovarian counterparts through induction of the female-specific RNA-binding protein TransformerF (TraF), though the underlying mechanism has remained unclear. Here, we identify the pioneer transcription factor Zelda (Zld) as a critical mediator of this sex reversal. In wild-type CySCs, zld mRNA is repressed by microRNAs (miRs), but following Chinmo loss, these miRs are downregulated, allowing zld mRNA to be translated. Zld is necessary for feminization of chinmo-mutant CySCs, and ectopic expression of Zld in wild-type CySCs is sufficient to induce TraF and drive female reprogramming. Two Zld target genes, qkr58E-2 and Ecdysone receptor (EcR), are upregulated in chinmo-mutant CySCs and are normally female-biased in adult gonads. Qkr58E-2 facilitates TraF production, while EcR promotes female gene expression programs. Zld overexpression feminizes otherwise wild-type CySCs by upregulating EcR, which in turn downregulates the chinmo gene. Strikingly, overexpression of Zld also feminizes adult male adipose tissue by inducing TraF and downregulating Chinmo, indicating that Zld can override male identity in multiple adult XY tissues. Together, these findings uncover a post-transcriptional mechanism in which miRs-mediated repression of a pioneer factor safeguards male identity and prevents inappropriate activation of the female program in adult somatic cells.
abstract_zh: 维持体细胞性别身份对于成体组织功能至关重要。在果蝇睾丸中，被称为包囊干细胞（cyst stem cells, CySCs）的成体体细胞干细胞需要转录因子Chinmo来保持雄性身份。Chinmo的缺失通过诱导雌性特异性RNA结合蛋白TransformerF（TraF）导致CySCs重编程为其卵巢对应细胞，尽管其潜在机制尚不清楚。在此，我们鉴定先驱转录因子Zelda（Zld）为这一性别逆转的关键介导因子。在野生型CySCs中，zld mRNA被微RNA（miRs）抑制，但在Chinmo缺失后，这些miRs下调，使得zld mRNA得以翻译。Zld是chinmo突变CySCs雌性化所必需的，且在野生型CySCs中异位表达Zld足以诱导TraF并驱动雌性重编程。两个Zld靶基因qkr58E-2和蜕皮激素受体（Ecdysone receptor, EcR）在chinmo突变CySCs中上调，且在成体性腺中通常呈雌性偏向。Qkr58E-2促进TraF产生，而EcR促进雌性基因表达程序。Zld过表达通过上调EcR使原本野生型的CySCs雌性化，而EcR反过来下调chinmo基因。引人注目的是，Zld过表达还通过诱导TraF和下调Chinmo使成体雄性脂肪组织雌性化，表明Zld能在多种成体XY组织中覆盖雄性身份。总之，这些发现揭示了一种转录后机制，其中miRs介导的先驱因子抑制保护了雄性身份，并阻止成体体细胞中雌性程序的不当激活。
